title: Events
ackLocalOnly: acknowledgement is stored only in this browser
logNote: Current alarms are below, followed by the hub's own log.
offlineHint: Check the rbAmp module’s power and the I2C cable to the hub. If that doesn’t help, contact your installer.
seenSince: seen in this browser since {time} (the hub log has no poll failure for this module — perhaps it wasn’t found at start-up)
lostSince: No connection to the hub since {time}. The alarm state is unknown — the last known is shown below.
lostNever: No connection to the hub. The alarm state is unknown.
bootDown: It was off or down for ≈ {dur}; history records for that time may be missing, but “today” counts it from the hub's counters.
hubFailSince: the hub has logged poll failures since {time}
hubNotFoundSince: the hub didn’t find the module at start-up ({time}) and keeps looking
